chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
There is no valid emancipation except that by which the Face of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, is intended.

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: al-Sadiq, Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad عليه السلام
key_terms.عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: Mighty and Majestic, an honorific for Allah
key_terms.عِتْقَ: emancipation or manumission of a slave
key_terms.وَجْهُ اللَّهِ: the sake and pleasure of Allah

ai.seo_question: Is emancipation valid in Islam if it is not done sincerely for the sake of Allah?
ai.summary: This hadith states that emancipation is only valid when it is intended purely for the sake of Allah, Mighty and Majestic. It emphasizes that acts with legal and moral significance must be grounded in sincerity and directed toward divine pleasure.
